title: ECMP row claims 2 pkts/tick per wide is 'under' a wide's 1.33 pkts/tick service
location: surge-explainer.html: Section B 'The levers that do exist' table, ECMP row
evidence: Base demand through one bundle = 6 arrivals/tick = 180 u/s (4×30 + 2×30). Split across 3 equal-cost wides: 60 u/s each = 2 packets/tick — under the 1.33/tick service of one wide; with ECMP the load lands on whichever bundle is on the hash. | Same doc, ranked table row 3: A pair of parallel wides = 80 u/s ≈ 2.7 packets/tick — meaningful but not enough for base demand alone (that needs ~180 u/s ≈ 4–5 wides through one pair).
detail: 60 u/s demand per wide exceeds a wide's 40 u/s (1.33 pkts/tick) service; three wides still saturate under base demand. The doc's own ranked table says 4–5 wides are needed.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the cell: '60 u/s each exceeds one wide's 1.33/tick service — 3 wides still saturate; base demand needs ~5 equal-cost wides.'

title: 'u/s = u per tick' justification is false arithmetic at 20 Hz; every derived number treats capacity as per-tick
location: surge-explainer.html: Section B, 'First, the unit' note
evidence: a pipe's u/s is how many it provides per second (the sim ticks at 20 Hz, so u/s = u per tick). Transit time per hop = ceil(30 ÷ capacity): narrow (5 u/s) = 6 ticks (0.3 s), standard (15) = 2 ticks (0.1 s), wide (40) = 1 tick.
detail: At 20 Hz a per-second rate is 20× a per-tick rate; the parenthetical is self-contradictory. All derived figures (6-tick transit, 0.167 pkts/tick, 180 u/s) treat capacity as per-tick; the spec and cards inherit this convention.
recommended_fix: State plainly that capacity_units are applied per tick despite the 'u/s' catalog label (or correct the numbers ×20); delete the false 'so u/s = u per tick' clause.

title: Explainer sim Reset leaves controls visually out of sync with the reset state
location: surge-explainer.html: script, btn-reset handler vs fresh() defaults
evidence: document.getElementById('btn-reset').addEventListener('click', () => { state = fresh(); running = false; document.getElementById('btn-pause').textContent = "Run"; document.getElementById('btn-pause').classList.remove('on'); draw(); updateReadouts(); }); | fresh(): surge: false, emailBE: false, pipeCap: 15, parallel: false
detail: Reset restores defaults (surge off, pipeCap 15, router 40) but never clears the 'on' class on the Surge/Email→BE/parallel buttons nor resets the tier/router selects — the UI shows stale active state after Reset.
recommended_fix: In the reset handler also remove 'on' from btn-surge/btn-be/btn-par and reset sel-pipe/sel-router to their default options.

title: CAP_FRACTION goes straight to balance.json while the spec's own precedent says new tuning values start as core consts
location: spec-traffic-model.md: Thread 2 balance lever, Thread 3 balance levers, §4 determinism spine
evidence: Playtest-tunable; `balance.json` holds CAP_FRACTION. | Data-driven (balance.json) at the legitimate re-bless; core consts until then (the growth precedent — 5.1's tuning lives as consts for exactly this reason). | New tuning values follow the growth precedent (core consts → balance.json at the legitimate re-bless).
detail: Two new tuning knobs in the same slice get contradictory homes under the spec's own rule: group radius waits as a const, CAP_FRACTION lands in balance.json immediately.
recommended_fix: State the exception explicitly (this slice is itself the legitimate re-bless event) or hold CAP_FRACTION as a const until the slice boundary like the group radius.

title: spawn_credit 'rebuilt by the spawn pass each tick' contradicts cross-tick credit accrual
evidence: State home: `spawn_credit[terminal_slot]` — a per-terminal buffer in the director's pressure state (demand.odin), slot-keyed like `lane_caps`, rebuilt by the spawn pass each tick. | Credit is bounded at a **burst ceiling** `MAX_CREDIT = 2` (a terminal may burst up to 2 in a tick after idling; its long-run rate stays the cap — bounded short-spike honesty, no unbounded bursts).
detail: A buffer rebuilt from scratch each tick cannot carry idle credit forward, yet 'burst after idling' and 1-spawn-per-~12-ticks rates require a persistent balance; card authors may implement a per-tick reset.
recommended_fix: Reword to 'maintained across ticks by the spawn pass (accrue, spend, clamp at MAX_CREDIT); replay-derivable, never serialized'.

title: Story 5.9 golden clause 'existing goldens unshifted at the const level' is undefined and tensions with the spawn-sequence shift
location: stories-v2.md: Story 5.9, Edge-case contracts / Golden line
evidence: **Golden:** T1 (spawn sequence shift — **deliberate, cause-documented re-bless** per the 4.3 discipline; byte-verify `.log.bin` differs only in the version field, splice the old catalog_hash, cause-document); existing goldens unshifted at the const level.
